bias.en: Pullback · broke $492–503, testing the summer lows
bias.zh: 回调 · 跌破 $492–503，测试夏季低点

read.en: AMD fell 7.5% on Nov 2 to $466.84, trading between $466.07 and $512.82 on 1.6 times average volume. It is below the 5-day ($535.4), 10-day ($532.0), 100-day ($529.2) and falling 30-day ($581.7), and above the rising 200-day ($411.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($577.44), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: AMD 11月2日下跌 7.5%，收于 $466.84，盘中区间 $466.07–512.82，成交量为均量的 1.6 倍。股价位于上行的 5 日（$535.4）和 100 日均线（$529.2）以及下行的 10 日（$532.0）和 30 日均线（$581.7）下方，位于上行的 200 日均线（$411.7）上方。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$577.44），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The drop broke the $492.2–502.6 support (Oct 30, Jun 29 and Oct 22 lows), now resistance. Resistance is $492.2–502.6, then $512.8–520.4 (Nov 2 and Oct 30 highs) and $529.2–535.4 (100, 10 and 5-day). Support is $460.2–463.2 (Jul 17 and Aug 11 lows), then $440.5–451 and $424–437.2 (July–September lows). A close above $502.6 would target $513–520; below $460, $440–451.

r.en: Oct 30 low $492.2; Jun 29 low $495.4; Oct 22 low $502.6, lost
